notes.title: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders is at devINITIVE - Showcase 2025!
notes.content: [p]Hello, dear gamers![/p][p]We've been here for a long time to announce that Alien Strike will be at the Steam devINITIVE - Showcase 2025 Event![/p][p]devINITIVE was created to give a voice to independent developers in Spain and Latin America, and it's an honor to be a part of it![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uQk0r2MdGDA"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Ending and Next Steps
notes.content: [p]Hello, dear gamers![/p][p]Our playtest of Alien Strike Blasting the Intruders has concluded! And it was excellent! In two weeks, we had almost 1,000 players testing and sending us feedback on various platforms, whether through Steam or social media, and this was essential to get a feel for the experience we want to give players with our game![/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, the Community Hub page here on Steam used for the playtest goes offline when the playtest ends. Therefore, the feedback we received on this page is no longer public, with only the Community Hub page on the fixed online page on Steam remaining.[/p][p][/p][p]But don't worry, we received all the feedback and it helped us immensely! We are very happy with the reception from all of you![/p][p][/p][p]And we want to let you know that the game doesn't stop there. With the play test, we'll be continually improving the demo version we created and making it available on the Steam page soon, so everyone can follow the game until its release![/p][p][/p][p]Get ready for more stages, characters, and challenges we're creating for the world of Alien Strike! Follow our pages for the latest news, and follow Nuntius Games! Many surprises are coming![/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much, you're amazing!!![/p]

notes.title: 2,000 wishlists!
notes.content: [p]Hello, dear players![/p][p]We've reached the 2,000 wishlist mark here on Steam! We're so happy to see how much you're enjoying the project and helping us with your feedback! All of this was only possible thanks to you![/p][p]Thank you so much![/p]
